parsed.explanation: 1) Added missing closing </BIBL> for the third bibliographic entry (Stettlers) which was left unclosed before </ITEM>. 2) Split the incorrectly combined entry: 'Schweitzer-Chronick' and 'Reich der Todten' were inside one BIBL - separated into two distinct <BIBL> elements: <BIBL><AUTHOR>Stettlers</AUTHOR><TITLE>Schweitzer-Chronick</TITLE></BIBL> and <BIBL><TITLE>Reich der Todten</TITLE></BIBL>. 3) Moved the trailing general description ('samt noch einigen anderen neuen... in Commission hat.') outside of the BIBL scope where it was incorrectly included. 4-7) Fixed 4 mojibake/encoding errors: frantz\u221a\u2202sisch -> französischen, B\u221a\u00bcheren -> Bücheren, B\u221a\u00bcher -> Bücher, Commi- \u221a\u00fcion -> Commission and normalized hyphen spacing in 'Schweitzer- Chronick' -> 'Schweitzer-Chronick'.
